_about: Defaults for scripts/run_benchmark.py and the dataset0921-benchmark skill. main_preset is 'our system' whenever an experiment does not name one. A suite is a named set of presets; presets whose 'tasks' do not include the dataset's task are skipped (e.g. arf100 on a regression stream, htr on a classification stream).

standard.description: Main method + strong baselines (ARF 100 trees, SRP) + no-drift-handling baselines (HT, NB; HT regressor on regression streams). The default set for a SOTA comparison.

quick.description: Cheaper version of standard (ARF with 10 trees, no SRP) for a first look; ARF10 is not the configuration the literature reports.

ablation.description: Main method vs plain ECPF (paper settings) and ECPF with reuse-value fading, all on a single Hoeffding Tree.

det1.description: DET1 A0-A5 and A5u secondary ECPF arms plus A6 E10bFT; dataset scope skips A0 on incremental. Detector-only presets are run separately on injected data.

pool_fade.description: Memory-aware model-pool fade mechanisms (density, rent, entry, freq, decay, subst) on the e10bft and ecpf_reuse_value backbones, with e10bft, ecpf_paper and ecpf_reuse_value as references. Run with --pool-trace.
